interventions.description: Reduce the number and width of curb cuts to minimize the number of conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway to the minimum required for safe vehicle entry, thereby reducing the exposure distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and elevation across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and encourage slower vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the parking lot.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes through restriping to naturally slow traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reducing the width of the driveway to standard dimensions would minimize the conflict zone and restore the sidewalk's protective curb.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Adding a high-visibility crosswalk with signage would provide a safer, designated path for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer
interventions.description: Implementing a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway would improve pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffering
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to provide physical separation from the roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Dedicated Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Install a clearly marked or physically separated walkway from the street edge to the storefront entrances.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting poles specifically designed to illuminate pedestrian paths to improve safety and visibility during evening hours.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming and Signage
interventions.description: Implement speed humps and clear 'Pedestrian Crossing' signage within the parking lot to slow vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions and restrict parking near the driveway/alley to improve sightlines and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune overhanging trees and shrubs to clear the full width of the sidewalk on the right side.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Protection
interventions.description: Expand the walkway to at least 6 feet and install bollards or a planting buffer to prevent vehicles from parking on or blocking the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Marked Pedestrian Crossings
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and signage to define a clear path for pedestrians across the wide asphalt area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Completion
interventions.description: Widen existing sidewalks to at least 6 feet and ensure a continuous paved path on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation or Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the driveway apron to reduce vehicle turning speeds and minimize the exposure distance for pedestrians.
